notes.text: The gazelle interpretation gives Yochanan ben Katzarta in Rabbi Yonah’s name on the forty-five days of concealment.
The checked digital edition gives Yochanan de-Kartzayon in the name of Rabbi Nachum bar Simai on a flame. Keep Heilprin’s received name form and locator.
The Menachem entry discusses the Nachum form and explicitly lists this transmission. The pointer keeps the named source forms separate.
The parallel gives Yochanan de-Katzayon in Rabbi Nachum be-Rabbi Simai’s name, with no resh in the place epithet in the checked text.
The Bavli has a separate Rabbi Yose ben Katzarta, in whose name Rabbi Yochanan transmits. The other entry records the form and the compiler’s correction.
The digital text gives Rabbi Yitzchak bar Katzatzta in Rabbi Yonah’s name about the length of David’s reign in Jerusalem.
The matching teaching in the checked Krakow 1893 text is at 26:5, with Yitzchak bar Katzarta in Rabbi Yonah’s name. Chapter 29 follows David’s last words. Preserve the received chapter number.

Both works on David’s reign attest Yitzchak in Rabbi Yonah’s name. Shir HaShirim Rabbah attests Yochanan in Rabbi Yonah’s name in a different tradition. Preserve the tentative scribal-error proposal without merging them.
Keep Heilprin’s distinct DeKatzrinon and DeKatzinan renderings and record the differing digital forms de-Kartzayon and de-Katzayon. Collation against the edition known to Heilprin remains pending.
